class.name: NNCustomPropertyConsideration
class.brief_description: Scores a behaviour from a numeric property of any node.
class.description: Reads a numeric property named [member property_name] from [member node_with_property] on every evaluation and divides its float value by [member property_max_value] to produce [member NNConsiderations.score]. Scores [code]0.0[/code] when disabled, in the editor, when [member node_with_property] is not set, or while [member NNConsiderations.has_vetoed] is [code]true[/code]. Unlike [NNConsideration], it does not use a sensor input or cache scores between evaluations.

method.name: sample_activation_curve
method.description: Returns the y-value of the activation curve at [param input_value], or [code]0.0[/code] when no curve is set.

members.member: The node whose [member property_name] property is read. The consideration scores [code]0.0[/code] when this is not set. If the node is freed, this property reads as [code]null[/code] and is treated as unset.
Divisor applied to the float value of [member property_name] to produce [member NNConsiderations.score]. Must be finite and non-zero; invalid assignments report an error and keep the previous value.
The name of the numeric property read from [member node_with_property] via [method Object.get] and cast to [float].
